title: B 组实测：OSPF 互联接口关闭与修复

environment.source: B 组隔离 Linux 网络命名空间实测

goals.title: R1 → R2 直连接口 Ping（对照）
R1 学到远端 OSPF 路由 192.168.20.0/24
R1 观察到 2.2.2.2 的 Full 邻接
R2 学到远端 OSPF 路由 192.168.10.0/24
R2 观察到 1.1.1.1 的 Full 邻接
R2 互联接口管理状态为 UP

R1.config:
Building configuration...

Current configuration:
!
frr version 10.2.2
frr defaults traditional
hostname R1
! host identity omitted
no ipv6 forwarding
log stdout
! host identity omitted
!
interface lan
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
 ip ospf passive
exit
!
interface transit
 ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
 ip ospf dead-interval 4
 ip ospf hello-interval 1
 ip ospf network point-to-point
exit
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 1.1.1.1
exit
!
end
